caption:
Meet other couples. Make new friends.

CouplesConnect helps you and your partner make platonic friends through small, shared Plans—for coffee, dinner, games and more.

Explore a Plan or host your own. Send a short introduction to request a place; joining depends on approval and available space. Accepted couples coordinate through the Plan chat.

Just 2 or 3 couples total, including the hosts.

The browser product is live in supported Indian cities. We’re in early beta, so local Plan availability will vary. No app download is needed.

Try it at couplesconnect.site — link in bio.

Know a couple who might enjoy this? Share this with them. If you try it, we’d appreciate honest feedback on getting started.

#CouplesConnect #CoupleFriends #MakeNewFriends #India

assets.altText: CouplesConnect helps couples meet other couples for platonic friendship through small shared Plans in India.
Discover an activity Plan or host your own. Request to join with a short introduction. Once accepted, coordinate in Plan chat.
Plans include two or three couples total, including the hosts. Example only: Sunday coffee and conversation in Noida for two couples total. This is not a scheduled event.
A request is not a confirmed place. Joining needs approval and room in the Plan. Accepted couples coordinate in Plan chat. Meet in public and keep sensitive details private.
Try CouplesConnect in your browser at couplesconnect.site. Explore Plans or host your own in supported Indian cities. Early beta; local Plan availability varies. Link in bio.
